text.p: -- Montgomery Securities analyst Michael Moe said he initiated coverage of Snyder Communications Inc with a buy rating.

-- Moe said he expects the company to earn $0.15 per share in fiscal 1996, $0.35 per share in 1997 and $0.52 per share in 1998. His target price is $35 per share, or about 46 percent above current levels.

-- Snyder Communicatins is a marketing services outsourcer that designs sales and marketing programs for corporate clients seeking to increase market share. The programs are designed to penetrate difficult to reach consumers in high-value and rapidly-growing niches, especially in "multicultural" and "elderly" markets, Moe said.
-- Shares were trading up 1-1/8 at 24 in midafternoon exchange trading.
